definitions.never_evaluated: hash matches the 1 October manifest, the manifest records reserve_evaluated false, no record carries a reserve identifier, no record pairs a reserve donor with its reserve recipient, and no record holds a reserve full-problem prompt in the reserve wording (machine)
definitions.coincidences: first-step prompts depend only on (a, b, first) and the remaining-step and supplied-intermediate prompts only on (z, operation, k), so independently generated items from the same small ranges share them; complete problems can also coincide across independently generated sets
